# Command line: `yerux`

<!-- generated by scripts/gen_cli_doc.py from the command table in src/cli_help.rs: `yerux --help`, `yerux help COMMAND` and `yerux COMMAND --help` print the same words (tests/cli_help.sh checks that every command is listed here) -->

`yerux COMMAND [ARGS]`. `yerux --help` lists the commands on stdout (exit 0), `yerux help COMMAND` and `yerux COMMAND --help` describe one. A wrong command line prints a usage to stderr and exits 2; a failed check, test or program exits 1 (or the program's own status for `run`). Flags after `--` belong to the program (`yerux run prog.yx -- --help`).

## Commands

| Command | What it does |
|---|---|
| [`check`](#check) | type- and ownership-check a program; no output file |
| [`c`](#c) | print the generated C |
| [`ir`](#ir) | print the optimized IR of the native backend |
| [`build`](#build) | compile a program (or the project in the current directory) to an executable |
| [`run`](#run) | compile and run a program (or the project in the current directory) |
| [`test`](#test) | run the `test "name" { ... }` blocks of files, directories or the current project |
| [`fmt`](#fmt) | format source files in place (the only style) |
| [`doc`](#doc) | generate API documentation from `///` comments |
| [`lsp`](#lsp) | language server on stdin/stdout |
| [`bench`](#bench) | time the `bench "name" { ... }` blocks of programs |
| [`new`](#new) | create a project |
| [`add`](#add) | add a dependency to yerux.toml |
| [`remove`](#remove) | remove a dependency |
| [`lock`](#lock) | write or verify yerux.lock |
| [`obj`](#obj) | separately compiled module objects |
| [`version`](#version) | print the version |
| [`doctor`](#doctor) | check the C compiler, the backends and the paths |
| [`tokens`](#tokens) | debug: dump the lexer's tokens |

## `check`

Type- and ownership-check a program; no output file.

```
yerux check FILE.yx
```

Prints `ok: no type or ownership errors` or the diagnostics (exit 1). Follows `import`s relative to FILE.


## `c`

Print the generated C.

```
yerux c FILE.yx
```

The C backend's translation unit on stdout (needs no C compiler).


## `ir`

Print the optimized IR of the native backend.

```
yerux ir FILE.yx
```

A textual dump of the IR the native x86-64/AArch64/Windows backends compile.


## `build`

Compile a program (or the project in the current directory) to an executable.

```
yerux build FILE.yx [-o OUT] [--native] [--target linux|aarch64|windows] [--debug|--release] [--dwarf] [--no-opt] [--native-debug-alloc] [--obj MOD.yxo] [--separate]
       yerux build [--locked]
```

Without --native the C backend is used (the C compiler is $YERUX_CC, else the first of cc, gcc, clang that runs; without one the native backend is used). --native emits a static ELF/PE directly. --target aarch64 builds a Linux AArch64 ELF, --target windows a PE32+ .exe. --debug is a native build with DWARF and no optimization, --release the default. --native-debug-alloc reports allocations on stderr at exit. With no FILE and a yerux.toml in the directory the project is built (--locked: fail when yerux.lock is out of date).


## `run`

Compile and run a program (or the project in the current directory).

```
yerux run FILE.yx [build flags] [-- ARGS...]
       yerux run [--locked]
```

Same flags as `build`. Everything after `--` is passed to the program; the program's exit status is yerux's.


## `test`

Run the `test "name" { ... }` blocks of files, directories or the current project.

```
yerux test [FILE.yx|DIR ...] [--native] [--no-opt] [--filter TEXT] [--locked]
```

Exit 0 when every test passes. --filter keeps the tests whose name contains TEXT.


## `fmt`

Format source files in place (the only style).

```
yerux fmt [--check|--stdout] FILE.yx|DIR ...
```

--check lists the files that would change and exits 1; --stdout prints the formatted text of one file. `target/` and hidden directories are skipped. Formatting twice gives the same text and never changes what a program compiles to.


## `doc`

Generate API documentation from `///` comments.

```
yerux doc [--html] [-o DIR] [DIR|FILE.yx ...]
```

One page per module plus an index, Markdown by default (HTML with --html), for the `pub` items and the methods of public types; `//!` lines or the leading comment block describe the module. Default output directory: target/doc.


## `lsp`

Language server on stdin/stdout.

```
yerux lsp
```

Diagnostics, hover, definition, references, rename, completion, signature help, document symbols, formatting and semantic tokens (docs/LSP.md).


## `bench`

Time the `bench "name" { ... }` blocks of programs.

```
yerux bench [FILE.yx|DIR ...] [--native] [--no-opt] [--filter TEXT] [--runs N]
```

Runs each program once as a warm-up (a failing exit status is a failure) and then N timed runs (default 5); prints min, median and mean wall time.


## `new`

Create a project.

```
yerux new NAME
```

Creates NAME/ with yerux.toml, src/main.yx and a tests/ directory.


## `add`

Add a dependency to yerux.toml.

```
yerux add NAME --path DIR [--version REQ]
       yerux add NAME --git URL [--tag TAG | --version REQ]
```

Updates yerux.lock.


## `remove`

Remove a dependency.

```
yerux remove NAME
```

Updates yerux.toml and yerux.lock.


## `lock`

Write or verify yerux.lock.

```
yerux lock [--locked | --update]
```

--locked fails if the lock file would change; --update re-resolves every dependency.


## `obj`

Separately compiled module objects.

```
yerux obj build MOD.yx [-o OUT.yxo] | obj info MOD.yxo | obj check MOD.yxo [--root DIR]
```

Packs a module that type-checks into a .yxo; `build --obj` links against it (docs/MODULE_OBJECT.md).


## `version`

Print the version.

```
yerux --version | -V | version
```


## `doctor`

Check the C compiler, the backends and the paths.

```
yerux doctor
```

Exit 0 when a backend is usable.


## `tokens`

Debug: dump the lexer's tokens.

```
yerux tokens FILE.yx | tokens-positioned FILE.yx
```

Also: ast-file, ast-expr, ast-stmt, resolve-file, locals-file and types-file FILE.yx dump the front end's internal views (used by the self-hosting tests).


## Environment

| Variable | Effect |
|---|---|
| `YERUX_CC` | the C compiler of the C backend (otherwise the first of `cc`, `gcc`, `clang` that runs; none found: the native backend) |
| `YERUX_LOCS`, `YERUX_BACKTRACE` | keep source locations / a backtrace in panic messages of C builds |
| `YERUX_LSP_DEBOUNCE_MS` | typing pause before `yerux lsp` publishes diagnostics (default 150) |

`yerux --selfhost COMMAND ...` runs the self-hosted front end ([SELFHOST.md](SELFHOST.md)).

## Exit status

| Code | Meaning |
|---|---|
| 0 | success (for `run`: the program's own status) |
| 1 | diagnostics, failed tests, unformatted files under `fmt --check`, or an error reading the project |
| 2 | a bad command line (unknown command or option, missing argument, unreadable path) |
| 101 | a Yerux program panicked |
